answer_decisions.reason: 1919并非所问短篇初刊1918；续篇或后版年份不能代替首次出版。

answer_decisions.exact_final: The initial magazine publication year of the Abraham Merritt story whose depiction of Nan Madol inspired its use in H. P. Lovecraft and Hazel Heald's "Out of the Aeons" is 1918. The story in question is "The Moon Pool," which first appeared as a short story in *All-Story Weekly* in 1918 (with its sequel, "Conquest of the Moon Pool," following in 1919).
answer_decisions.reason: 明确采用1918，1919只用于区分续篇而没有否定1918；不把整个Explanation严格EM，也不因另一个年份出现判错。
